name: What should I prepare before a finish carpentry crew arrives?
description: Clear work areas, ensure electrical outlets are installed, and confirm your desired paint/stain finishes before the finish carpentry crew arrives.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a finish carpentry crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a finish carpentry crew arrives, it's beneficial to clear the work areas of furniture, decor, and personal items to provide unobstructed access. Ensure that electrical outlets and switches are installed if new trim will be placed around them. Having a clear idea of your desired paint or stain finishes for the new carpentry can also streamline the process, as this decision often impacts the final sanding and preparation steps. Providing access to power outlets and a designated area for cutting tools will also help the crew work efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear work areas, ensure electrical outlets are installed, and confirm your desired paint/stain finishes before the finish carpentry crew arrives.
